exchanges.q: How do I export the whole workspace, including attachments?
exchanges.a: An Owner or Admin exports it as JSON from Settings, then Data, then Export workspace [help:data-export@6#2]; attachments come separately as a ZIP [help:data-export@6#0].

exchanges.q: Who on our team can run that export?
exchanges.a: Owners and Admins can export the workspace; any member can export a single project as CSV [help:roles@4#1] [help:data-export@6#1].

exchanges.q: How long does the export usually take?
exchanges.a: Usually within an hour for large workspaces; the link is emailed and valid for 24 hours [help:data-export@6#3].

exchanges.q: Can I change a member's role to Admin myself?
exchanges.a: Yes, as an Owner: Settings, then Members, then the role menu next to their name [help:roles@4#3].

exchanges.q: Can I get a refund on a monthly plan?
exchanges.a: Monthly plans are not refunded, but you can cancel at any time and keep paid features until the period ends [help:refunds@4#1].
Annual plans can be refunded within 30 days of the first payment or a renewal, prorated [help:refunds@4#0].
The workspace owner opens Settings, then Billing, and chooses Cancel plan [help:refunds@4#2].

exchanges.q: Will removing members give us money back?
exchanges.a: No; unused time becomes a credit on the next invoice, not a refund [help:billing@5#3].

exchanges.q: How do we set up single sign-on with Okta?
exchanges.a: Under Settings, then Security, then Single sign-on, copy Fernway's ACS URL and entity ID into a SAML app in Okta, paste the metadata URL back and test [help:sso@8#1].

exchanges.q: Do we need to verify our domain first?
exchanges.a: Yes: add the TXT record under Settings, then Domains, before enforcing SSO [help:sso@8#2].

exchanges.q: What happens to password sign-in after that?
exchanges.a: Require SSO disables it for members; owners keep a password as a recovery path [help:sso@8#3].

exchanges.q: And can SCIM remove people automatically?
exchanges.a: Yes: deactivating a user in the identity provider removes their seat within minutes [help:sso@8#4].
